case.summary: Case CASE-013 (Card SC-03013-K951): The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012175 ($516.82, domestic) at 0.89, triggering review [EV-1b0e36b8]. The card SC-03013-K951 showed one prior transaction averaging $290.54 [EV-66d3b2bb] and two online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-7ca3d8a5]. The transaction originated from a device marked 'New' with a synthetic profile (Mac OS X 10_15_5 Firefox 89.0) [EV-91edce31] and used an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-6ecd485a]. The customer has one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4322) [EV-731fed45], and the same device profile appears in another confirmed fraud case [EV-c4a5e214]. Six prior closed cases share the 'card_not_present_new_device' pattern [EV-d3e4623e], and the customer disputes the transactions, stating they still possess the card [EV-c98ac046].

The primary transaction 4012175 ($516.82) was scored at 0.89 by the real-time risk model and originated from a previously unseen device profile (Mac OS X 10_15_5 Firefox 89.0 with synthetic identifiers) via an anonymous proxy connection routed through Argentina. The device profile has been linked to at least one other confirmed fraud case, and the customer has a prior fraud history (CC-4322). The customer affirms they did not authorize the purchases and retains physical possession of the card. The pattern aligns with six prior 'card_not_present_new_device' cases retrieved by pattern and keyword matching. The bank's deterministic policy engine has rendered a fraud verdict and closed the case as fraud. No further investigative action is recommended; the case is referred for loss recovery and pattern monitoring.
